bull.b: Tigo's dominant MLPE mix (82% of revenue) signals a durable product-market fit in distributed solar where module-level optimization and safety are increasingly required. High share of core hardware supports steadier OEM/distributor demand, cross-sell of software, and competitive moat versus newer entrants.

Material margin expansion to ~43% reflects favorable product mix and lower warranty charges, improving core profitability. Sustained higher gross margins provide buffer against sell-through volatility, enabling reinvestment in product development and supporting operating leverage as revenue scales.

bull.t: Conservative leverage and improved liquidity optionality
bull.b: Low reported debt and recent financing (equity raise, $11.6M cash, $10M undrawn credit line) materially improve runway and strategic flexibility. This reduces short-term refinancing risk and enables deliberate investment in product launches and utility-scale opportunities without immediate cash-flow pressure.

bear.t: Sharp decline in cash generation vs prior year
bear.b: A dramatic pullback in operating and free cash flow versus 2025 weakens the durability of the turnaround: the company may need repeated external financing to fund operations or working capital. Limited cash conversion reduces ability to self-fund rollout of new products and utility-scale expansion.

While accounting net income turned positive, persistent negative EBIT indicates core operating margins before capital costs and one-offs are not yet consistently profitable. That sensitivity leaves earnings vulnerable to margin pressure, hampering sustainable free-cash-flow conversion needed for reinvestment.

bear.t: Working-capital pressure and regional concentration risk
bear.b: Elevated inventory and rising receivables create working-capital strain that can erode liquidity during seasonality or distributor stress; this is amplified by revenue concentration in EMEA (69.5% of sales) and volatile Americas demand, increasing exposure to regional timing and distributor-credit risks.
